planning.progressUnit: estimated arithmetic operation units (source/basis/FFT/RHS/target/reference work); not measured FLOPs or an ETA

planning.timingDefinition: Raw total = shared CPU preparation + method CPU preparation + GPU preparation/evaluation submission wall times + result processing. Cooperative gaps between submissions are excluded. Checked total = raw total + the additional full checked pass; fixed-target bases charged once, streamed FMM target windows charged whenever rebuilt. Warm calibration and shared f64 references are excluded. GPU views use only pass timestamps; no CPU or readback substitution.

recovery: Completed results only. Live WASM/GPU state is not a restart checkpoint.
